searchText: I'm making some progress on (2) and (3), have a couple hundred lines of go which have TurboGeth read from the database and trace blocks and emit the set of touched accounts: Currently working on making sure I haven't missed any places it reads from the database, then I'll be ready to run it over the last million blocks. Does anyone have ideas for what format would be useful for sharing this with others? I think this dump could answer a lot of different questions and it might make sense to work on them in parallel. My current thought is to build and share a sqlite file with a schema which looks like a bunch of (block #, touched account) rows ? We can iterate on the format.
